name: BRAND TEXT
description:
Far North Saunas are an infrared sauna company based in Alberta, Canada. For many years they have been a popular choice with infrared sauna customers. Far North Saunas have a large range of products and they are made from allergy-free hemlock ensuring a rich detoxification for users. Far North Saunas have been designed for maximum therapeutic experience with LED chromotherapy lights coming as standard in most models.



The dual-core ceramic heating technology ensures all waves of infrared heat penetrate the body. The far infrared rays are most effective at giving users a passive cardio work out, raising metabolism for weight loss and improving blood circulation cell renewal both of which help with skin purification and pain management. Overall, the radiant heat emitted from the carbon heaters will penetrate 2 inches into the tissue for full health benefits.



Far North Saunas are a modular design and most models break into seven pieces that are easy to move between rooms and install. Most Far North Saunas only need a regular household plug to power and because they heat up quickly they are cheap and efficient to run and use regularly. Far North Saunas have easy to use control panels, adjustable lighting, reading and roof lights as well as either a stereo or input for a phone or iPod/MP3.
